title: RAW perfect sight requires qualified attention and medium while three likeness paths keep their endpoints
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. Complete owned Steele id00091 links perfect sight to faculty, organ, intervening air, attention and moderate movement, then distinguishes direct, reflected and deviating paths. Keep likeness, object, eye and reflecting/intervening medium roles separate; neither all presence nor one route name alone supplies the whole content. No modern optical correction or target values.

source_basis.unit: Complete id00091, from The sight is most simple through between the sight and the thing that is seen; preceding spirit paragraph90 and following colour list92 not imported as extra duties.
source_basis.edition: Robert Steele, Mediaeval Lore from Bartholomew Anglicus, owned Chapter I anthology; selected and modernized historical English, not a full medieval optics chapter or native witness.
source_basis.access: Already-owned local cache only; no network, images or new source acquisition.

design.linked_meaning: An object supplies a likeness whose path terminates at an eye; air is a necessary intervening means. The same account distinguishes the physiological efficient faculty and crystal-like organ from that medium, and adds attention and moderate movement as conditions of perfect sight. Three route descriptions then preserve the object/eye roles while changing the intervening relation: straight arrival; passage to a reflecting surface then rebound to sight; and lateral deviation through differently clear/thick intervening spaces without reflection. This is connected content, not an eye/mirror/air list. The three descriptions need not concern one physical object, one likeness parcel or one observer episode.
whole_source_duties: Opening characterizes sight as most simple and fiery and able to apprehend far things suddenly. Preserve this historical characterization rather than replacing it by modern optics.

A pure clear humour is located in the middle/black of the eye, called crystalloid by philosophers because it receives various colour forms like crystal; sight concerns colours, figures, shapes and outward properties.

The list of requirements for perfect sight names efficient cause, a suitable eye organ, air bringing likeness to the eye, attention and easy movement. Mere listing does not supply their distinct causal/instrumental/mediating roles.

Efficient cause is the animal faculty. The crystal-like humour in each eye is clear and round: clarity is connected to the text's beshine wording concerning spirit and air; roundness to resistance to injury. The precise beshine direction is uncertain and must not be silently modernized into one optical emission theory.

Air is the external assisting means without which sight cannot be perfect. This is necessity for perfect sight, not a claim that air alone guarantees it or that all imperfect sight is impossible without it.
When the soul is occupied with other matters, sight is less perfect because it does not judge the seen thing. Do not convert less perfect into necessarily no sensation or all-or-nothing blindness.

Too-swift continuous movement of the seen thing disturbs sight. Preserve the ensuing oar-appearing-broken example and its attributed swift-water explanation, even though later optics would distinguish refraction; do not repair this source account.
Direct sight: the likeness from the seen thing reaches sight along straight lines.
Reflected sight: the likeness goes from the thing to a shewer and is bent/rebounded from that surface to sight. The reflecting intermediate is neither the eye nor the original thing.

The third route is stretched between seen thing and sight but not bent and rebounded in the reflected-route sense; it can depart sideways from straightness when intervening spaces differ in clearness and thickness. Retain that wording and distinction; no Snell law, angles or modern numerical refractive index is provided.
concrete_contrast: Perfect sight equals mere arrival of a likeness: contradicted as a complete source paraphrase by attention and movement qualifications, but the source does not provide a modern factorial experiment or sufficient-condition proof.
All indirect paths are the reflected path: loses the stated contrast between rebound at a shewer and sideways deviation associated with differently clear/thick spaces.
A path has only a destination and arbitrary route name: cannot express the reflected intermediate and the separately supplied medium-dependent deviation without additional written relations.
An apparent broken oar means a broken physical oar: confuses the appearance with the object and overrides the explicit explanatory example.
Each of three route labels independently stores the complete optical sentence: could paraphrase the source but pays three whole-clause macros and supplies no reusable path consequence.
design.strongest_rival: Separate ordinary direct-arrival, rebound-at-surface and deviation-through-medium relations plus independent attention/movement qualifications can express the same source. A shared path constructor is an exploratory compression choice, not source-forced truth. Likewise a conjunction of explicit conditions need not be a new special perfection operator. A coherent full passage with ordinary constructions remains permitted; claiming word-part composition requires actual repeated written applications, not field names alone.
design.prospective_smallest_test: Before target fitting select this complete paragraph as source unit and a complete already-owned target unit, with explicit synopsis/omissions if any. If f85r2 whole-page exploration is selected, all existing473 reader consequences and every assigned recurrence remain mandatory; this producer has not read that table. Require at least two actually written object-to-eye relation applications with distinct intermediary structures, and an explicit perfect-sight qualification whose deletion changes the claim. Also own the third route and every remaining source duty. Do not freeze a local dictionary before checking its repeated forms throughout the selected whole unit. No preconfirmed-word prerequisite, no chosen target tokens here.
design.decision_value: A complete account with the same written endpoint roles and a real intermediate/rebound-versus-medium contrast would offer a different content constraint from simple sensory order. A generic list, three opaque clause labels, unexpressed attention or repaired source wording would leave the proposed advantage unestablished. Failure of a frozen guessed mapping would not refute all optical content.
